# REX MADDOX: HOSTILE WORLDS
[color=#FFD24A][bold]SEASON SEVEN: THE DEEP JUNGLE. NOW ON THE RELAY.[/bold][/color]
[italic]Dropped onto the worst worlds in human space with a knife, a flare and a camera crew. Every week he walks out. Every week he eats something he should not have.[/italic]
## WHO IS REX Rex Maddox was a stunt rigger on Gateway holo sets for eleven years before a producer watched him walk out of a burning set carrying the camera and the cameraman. The producer asked if he could do that on a real planet. Rex said he could do it on any planet. Seven seasons and forty worlds later, he is still trying to prove it.
## THE REX RULES - [bold]Rule one.[/bold] Find water before you find anything else. - [bold]Rule two.[/bold] Light the flare before you need the flare. - [bold]Rule three.[/bold] If it is bigger than you and it has more legs than you, it is not dinner. - [bold]Rule four.[/bold] If it is smaller than you and it has more legs than you, it might be dinner. - [bold]Rule five.[/bold] If you hear something in the vents, it is not the wind. Leave.
## THIS WEEK Season seven, episode four, [bold]The Green Hell[/bold]. Rex spends three nights in the jungle outside Lazarus Landing with nothing but a machete and a boonie hat, builds a shelter out of a dropship parachute and eats a beetle the size of his hand. The colony garrison collected him on the fourth morning. Rex would like it known that he was not lost. He was being thorough.
## FROM REX To everybody out there on a hostile world, and {colony}, that means you. I get dropped in for a week. You live there. You fix the processor in a storm, you walk the perimeter at night and you raise your kids in a place that wants to eat them. I just do it with a camera on me. Stay sharp. Drink clean water. Respect the jungle.
